testcase.name: ambiguous complex terms are distinct from homomeric and heteromeric ones
an unknown complex classification value is an error, not silently treated as a complex
GO aspect: GAF letters accepted, conflicting claim labels are not trusted, invalid labels are unknown
raw scores outside [0,1] are ignored with a note, like non-finite ones, and do not become evidence
percent identity outside 0..100 is unavailable, not a feature value
pipeline predictor names map to their own column; pooled unknown tools are named in the provenance
an empty predictor-status map is 'not supplied', never 'supplied and clean'
FBA with zero tested conditions is unavailable, not a measured value
inconsistent cohort counts are rejected rather than producing fractions above one
claim order does not change a candidate's vector or roles
extraction is linear: a prepared index serves many candidates and extract() agrees with extractAll()
context-only candidates carry no sequence evidence and never fake it
